title: Linda Jones and grass growing rapidly while fleeing a UFO

tellings.quote: Linda Jones in Manchester UK she was running with her children away from this UFO and the grass was growing rapidly under her feet

plain: A woman named Linda Jones in Manchester, England, was running with her children away from a UFO when the grass began growing rapidly under her feet, according to a researcher named Mike Masters. Masters tells it without naming a source, as a sign that time itself may behave strangely near these objects, which fits his idea that the visitors are humans from the future.
